title: Roamhaven Rewards Terms: The Credit and the Credit Balance
content:
**1. Value.** One Roamhaven Rewards credit is worth 1.00 USD on every tier.

**2. Rounding.** Credit amounts are rounded to the nearest cent, half up.

**3. The balance.** A member's credit balance is the credits available to that member. Earned credits, bonus credits and reinstated credits come into the balance; redeemed credits, expired credits and clawed-back credits go out of it.

**4. Statement.** Each member receives a monthly credit statement.

**5. No cash.** Credits cannot be paid out as cash.

**6. No transfer.** Credits cannot be moved to another member outside household pooling.

**7. No goodwill credit.** Support may not grant credits as goodwill.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Credit value | Rounding | Statement | Cash-out | Transfer outside household pooling | Goodwill credit by support |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Rewards Silver | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Rewards Gold | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Rewards Platinum | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Rewards Diamond | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Rewards Ambassador | 1.00 USD | Nearest cent, half up | Monthly | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

**Rounding.** An unrounded amount of 8.125 credits becomes 8.13 credits; 8.124 credits becomes 8.12 credits; 8.135 credits becomes 8.14 credits.

**Balance movements.** A member whose statement shows 40.00 credits earned, a 10.00-credit bonus and 12.50 credits reinstated, against 30.00 credits redeemed and 5.00 credits clawed back, holds a balance of 27.50 credits: 62.50 credits in, less 35.00 credits out.

**Value.** A balance of 27.50 credits is worth 27.50 USD when applied to a booking; it cannot be taken as 27.50 USD in cash.
